entries.head: kick off

senses.en: to start a project or meeting

example.en: Let's kick off with the numbers from last week.
example.zh: 先从上周的数据开始吧。

entries.l1_note: 启动是 kick off；kick out 是赶走。

entries.head: go through

senses.en: to examine something item by item

example.en: Let's go through the agenda line by line.
example.zh: 我们逐条过一下议程。

entries.l1_note: 逐条过是 go through；go over 偏复习、检查。

entries.head: walk through

senses.en: to explain something step by step

example.en: Can you walk us through the new flow?
example.zh: 能带我们过一遍新流程吗？

entries.l1_note: 逐步演示是 walk someone through，代词夹中间。

entries.head: circle back

senses.en: to return to a topic later

example.en: Let's circle back to pricing at the end.
example.zh: 价格我们最后再回来谈。

entries.l1_note: 回头再谈是 circle back (to)，商务口语常见。

entries.head: call on

senses.en: to ask someone to speak

example.en: I'll call on the design team first.
example.zh: 我先请设计团队说。

entries.l1_note: 请人发言是 call on；call off 是取消。

entries.head: weigh in

senses.en: to give your opinion in a discussion

example.en: Has anyone weighed in on the timeline yet?
example.zh: 时间表有人表态了吗？

entries.l1_note: 发表意见是 weigh in (on)；不是“称重”。

entries.head: nail down

senses.en: to finally agree on details

example.en: Let's nail down the date before everyone leaves.
example.zh: 趁人还在把日期敲定。

entries.l1_note: 敲定是 nail down；不是“钉下去”。

entries.head: pin down

senses.en: to make someone give a definite answer

example.en: I couldn't pin him down on the budget.
example.zh: 预算他一直没给准话。

entries.l1_note: 问实是 pin someone down on；pin down 也指按住。

entries.head: lock in

senses.en: to make something fixed and certain

example.en: We locked in the price before the vendor changed it.
example.zh: 供应商改价前我们把价格锁住了。

entries.l1_note: 锁定是 lock in；lock out 是锁在外面。

entries.head: firm up

senses.en: to make a plan more definite

example.en: We'll firm up the schedule after the client call.
example.zh: 跟客户通完电话再定日程。

entries.l1_note: 敲定计划是 firm up；firm 单独是坚定的。

entries.head: note down

senses.en: to write something down to remember it

example.en: Note down the action items as we go.
example.zh: 边开边把待办记下来。

entries.l1_note: 记下是 note down；note 单独是注意到。

entries.head: jot down

senses.en: to write something quickly

example.en: Jot down the names you don't know.
example.zh: 不认识的名字随手记一下。

entries.l1_note: 随手记是 jot down，比 write down 更轻。

entries.head: read out

senses.en: to read something aloud

example.en: He read out the list of owners before we started.
example.zh: 开会前他把负责人名单念了一遍。

entries.l1_note: 念出来是 read out；read up on 是查资料。

entries.head: run over

senses.en: to continue past the planned time

example.en: We're running over by ten minutes.
example.zh: 我们超时十分钟了。

entries.l1_note: 超时是 run over；run over 也指车碾过。

entries.head: break into

senses.en: to interrupt to add something

example.en: Can I break into the agenda for one quick update?
example.zh: 我能插一句议程，做个简短更新吗？

entries.l1_note: 插进议程是 break into；break out 是爆发。

entries.head: follow along

senses.en: to keep up with what is being said or shown

example.en: Open the doc so everyone can follow along.
example.zh: 把文档打开，让大家跟着看。

entries.l1_note: 跟着听是 follow along；follow up 是跟进。

entries.head: boil down to

senses.en: when the real issue is one thing

example.en: It boils down to who owns the budget.
example.zh: 说到底就是预算归谁管。

entries.l1_note: 归结为是 boil down to；不是“煮下来”。

entries.head: zero in on

senses.en: to focus on one thing

example.en: Let's zero in on the churn problem first.
example.zh: 先聚焦流失率的问题。

entries.l1_note: 聚焦是 zero in on，不是 zone in（后者不规范）。

entries.head: drill down

senses.en: to look at data in more detail

example.en: Can we drill down into the Shanghai numbers?
example.zh: 能拆一下上海的数据吗？

entries.l1_note: 拆数据是 drill down (into)，商务高频。

entries.head: scope out

senses.en: to look at something to understand it

example.en: We scoped out the client's setup before quoting.
example.zh: 报价前我们先摸清了客户的情况。

entries.l1_note: 摸清是 scope out；scope 单独是范围。

entries.head: roll out

senses.en: to launch something new across a group

example.en: We're rolling out the new process next month.
example.zh: 下个月推行新流程。

entries.l1_note: 推行是 roll out；roll up 是到场/卷起。

entries.head: phase in

senses.en: to introduce something gradually

example.en: The new rules will be phased in over two quarters.
example.zh: 新规分两个季度引入。

entries.l1_note: 分阶段引入是 phase in；phase out 是逐步淘汰。

entries.head: phase out

senses.en: to stop something gradually

example.en: The old system is being phased out by June.
example.zh: 老系统六月前逐步停用。

entries.l1_note: 逐步淘汰是 phase out；不是“关掉一下”。

entries.head: bring in

senses.en: to involve someone from outside

example.en: Let's bring in legal on this one.
example.zh: 这个把法务拉进来吧。

entries.l1_note: 引入外部人是 bring in；bring up 是提出话题。

entries.head: call in

senses.en: to ask someone to come to a meeting

example.en: We called in the vendor to explain the delay.
example.zh: 我们把供应商叫来解释了延期。

entries.l1_note: 叫来是 call in；打电话请病假也是 call in (sick)。

entries.head: rope in

senses.en: to persuade someone to join a task

example.en: They roped me in to run the workshop.
example.zh: 他们把我拉去主持工作坊。

entries.l1_note: 拉人入伙是 rope in，带一点“被套住”的意味。

entries.head: drag in

senses.en: to bring an unrelated subject into a discussion

example.en: Don't drag in last quarter's numbers — they're irrelevant.
example.zh: 别把上季度的数字扯进来，不相关。

entries.l1_note: 硬扯是 drag in；drag up 是翻旧账。

entries.head: sit in

senses.en: to attend a meeting without taking part

example.en: Can I sit in on the client call?
example.zh: 我能旁听一下客户电话吗？

entries.l1_note: 旁听是 sit in (on)；sit on 是压着不处理。

entries.head: stand in

senses.en: to take someone's place temporarily

example.en: I'll stand in for her at the review.
example.zh: 评审我替她出席。

entries.l1_note: 代替出席是 stand in for；stand by 是待命。
collocations: stand in at the last minute

entries.head: carry over

senses.en: to continue something at a later time

example.en: Let's carry this over to next week's sync.
example.zh: 这个顺延到下周的同步会吧。

entries.l1_note: 顺延是 carry over；carry out 是执行。
